title: Clarifying an essay at office hours
objectives: Explain what is unclear about your essay
Name the sources you are using
Check that you understood the teacher's advice

courseTemplate.setting: The essay uses chapters two and five. The teacher recommends one claim and three pieces of evidence.

roles.learner: A student working on an essay

courseTemplate.openingLine: Come in. Are you here about the essay outline?

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes. My argument feels too broad, and I'm not sure what to cut.
targetPatterns.example: Yes. My argument feels too broad, and I'm not sure what to cut.

targetPatterns.pattern: Mostly chapters two and five of the reader.
targetPatterns.example: Mostly chapters two and five of the reader.

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes. So I should narrow the question and use three examples to support one claim?
targetPatterns.example: Yes. So I should narrow the question and use three examples to support one claim?

targetPatterns.pattern: Professor Smith, do you have a moment after class?
targetPatterns.example: Professor Smith, do you have a moment after class?
targetPatterns.translation: Smith 教授，课后能占用您一点时间吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I didn't quite follow the part about regression models.
targetPatterns.example: I didn't quite follow the part about regression models.
targetPatterns.translation: 回归模型那部分我没完全听懂。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I get an extension on the assignment?
targetPatterns.example: Could I get an extension on the assignment?

targetPatterns.pattern: Would you be available during office hours this week?
targetPatterns.example: Would you be available during office hours this week?
targetPatterns.translation: 您这周办公时间方便吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm considering this topic for my thesis — what do you think?
targetPatterns.example: I'm considering this topic for my thesis — what do you think?
targetPatterns.translation: 我论文想选这个方向，您觉得如何？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you write a reference letter for my application?
targetPatterns.example: Could you write a reference letter for my application?

targetPatterns.pattern: I want to make sure I'm on the right track.
targetPatterns.example: I want to make sure I'm on the right track.

targetPatterns.pattern: How should I prioritize my reading list?
targetPatterns.example: How should I prioritize my reading list?
targetPatterns.translation: 阅读清单该怎么排优先级？

stages.title: Explain what is unclear about your essay
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Come in. Are you here about the essay outline?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain what is unclear about your essay in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes. My argument feels …”

stages.title: Name the sources you are using
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Which sources give you the strongest evidence?”
successCriteria: The learner can name the sources you are using in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Mostly chapters two and …”

stages.title: Check that you understood the teacher's advice
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Keep one claim and support it with three pieces of evidence. Does that help?”
successCriteria: The learner can check that you understood the teacher's advice in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes. So I should …”

languageNotes: 称呼教授用 Professor + 姓，别用 "Teacher"（英语里对大学老师不这么称呼）；请教问题先说明自己尝试过的思路，避免显得伸手党。
